item.title: 2016 Mercedes-Benz GL450 4MATIC at No Reserve
item.description: This 2016 Mercedes-Benz GL450 has remained registered in Florida following the initial sale at Mercedes-Benz of Orlando, and it was optioned from the factory with the Premium, Appearance, Lane Tracking, and Parking Assist packages. It is finished in Designo Diamond White Metallic over Almond Beige and Mocha MB-Tex and is powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter V6 linked with a seven-speed automatic transmission and a 4MATIC all-wheel-drive system. item.description: This 2014 Porsche Cayenne Diesel was sold new from Jackie Cooper Imports of Tulsa, Oklahoma, and remained registered in the state until it was acquired by the selling dealer in 2025. item.title: 2023 Winnebago Revel 4×4
item.description: This 2023 Winnebago Revel 4×4 was built on a 2022 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 2500 chassis, and it was purchased new by the seller who has added 24k miles. item.title: 36k-Mile 1998 Mitsubishi Eclipse GS-T Spyder 5-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 1998 Mitsubishi Eclipse GS-T Spyder shows 36k miles following registration history in Rhode Island and Florida and is powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-four paired with a five-speed manual transaxle. Finished in Minden Silver Pearl over gray leather, the car is equipped with a black convertible soft top, 16" chrome-finished five-spoke alloy wheels, front disc brakes, power steering, fog lights, cruise control, air conditioning, and a JVC CD stereo. item.title: 2015 Ferrari California T
item.description: This 2015 Ferrari California T was purchased new by the seller from Ferrari of Atlanta and now has 26k miles. The car is finished in Nero Daytona over Rosso and black leather and is powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.9-liter V8 paired with a replacement seven-speed dual-clutch automatic transaxle that was installed in September 2025. item.title: 2023 Porsche 911 Turbo S Coupe at No Reserve
item.description: This 2023 Porsche 911 Turbo S coupe was ordered with approximately $60k in options, some of which include a paint-to-sample Porsche Racing Green Metallic exterior finish in addition to the Heritage Design and SportDesign packages. It has 2,200 miles and is powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.7L flat-six linked with an eight-speed PDK dual-clutch automatic transaxle. Equipment includes a black canvas soft top, 15" steel wheels, body-color bumpers, and fixed-back bucket seats.
